player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Ajmuɛ 0 yebɛɛd '{choice0}'; Ajmuɛ 1 yebɛɛd '{choice1}'. Talmest -> Ajmuɛ 0 yettwassen.
message.round_mismatch: Ajmuɛ 0 yebɛɛd '{choice0}'; Ajmuɛ 1 yebɛɛd '{choice1}'. Ur tɣuri -> Ajmuɛ 1 yettwassen.

outcome.p0_wins: Amyur n 0 yerbeḥ ugar n yiberdan.
